title: ChapterBlueprint
description: Chapter-level planning artifact. Sits between concept_seed (story-wide truth) and scene_card (scene-level contract). Owns chapter mission, turn, reveal schedule, subplot obligations, pacing, and exit vector. Phase 2 defines the schema; Phase 3 wires the Chapter Gate Critic to consume it.

chapter_mission.description: What this chapter must accomplish structurally. One or two sentences.

chapter_turn.description: The chapter-level turning point — how the POV character's or the story's state shifts across the chapter as a whole, distinct from any single scene's turn.

structural_phase.description: Larger-scale structural phase this chapter belongs to. Matches scene_card.structural_phase enum.

pov_allocation.description: POV characters that carry scenes in this chapter, in appearance order.

scene_count.description: Number of scenes in the chapter.

scene_plan.description: Per-scene skeleton. Each item is the chapter-level intent for a scene; the full drafting contract lives in the matching scene_card file.

role.description: Narrative function within the chapter. Matches scene_card.scene_role.

target_word_count.description: Target word count for this scene. Should match the paired scene_card.target_word_count.

purpose.description: One-sentence statement of what the scene does for the chapter's mission.

reveal_payload.description: Revelation IDs (from concept_seed.revelations) that land in this chapter.

hook_movements.description: Chapter-level hook agenda. Each array holds hook_ids from concept_seed.hooks.

subplot_obligations.description: Subplot IDs (from concept_seed.subplots) this chapter must touch.

relationship_turns.description: Relationship-level state changes that must land in this chapter.

to.description: New relationship state at chapter end.

pacing_curve.description: Shape of the chapter's pressure curve across its scenes.

exit_vector.description: The energy and direction the chapter should leave the reader with. Informs the final scene's closing hook.

chapter_word_target.description: Target total word count for the chapter. Sum of scene target_word_counts typically matches this.

notes.description: Planner-level notes about the chapter. Parallel to scene_card.notes for scene-level.
